answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long vesting window, then weight each identity by a periodic liveness pulse signed with a hardware-bound key. A nebula of cloned addresses cannot fake independent uptime or independent bonds, so their pooled influence never climbs to the zenith a single honest, long-bonded agent reaches. Because cost scales linearly per fresh identity, minting sybils stays uneconomic.
